note: Operational defaults, not architecture constants. Tune from measurement (P1-D).

proposal_only.description: Model returns a patch or typed artifact; agentctl validates paths, hashes, scope, and shape before applying it to the assigned worktree.

sandboxed_tools.description: Enforced read/write and process boundaries scoped to the worktree. Denies other worktrees, the integration checkout, runtime state, and credentials.

unsandboxed_tools.description: Postcondition checks only. Globally serialized and secret-free.

postcondition_diff_checks: mandatory in all classes; supplements rather than replaces containment
